signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Bottleneck defenders realize that the best way to stop a route is to act early. When they enter the zone, they are highly likely to dominantly win any man press encounter.
Defenders with this ability apply bonus fatigue to their man coverage target after a successful press win
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Players with this ability have an increased chance to catch passes that have been tipped into the air.
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Blockers with this ability start every new blocking encounter with built-in resistance
Blockers with this ability defend against spin pass rush moves as if they had an additional resistance point
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against outside zone plays.
Effective D-Line captains aren't just examples to follow, they are motivators. When they enter the zone, all opposing blockers have their resistance bars wiped out.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against inside run plays.
Defenders with this ability are less likely to increase their blocker's resistance bars when performing shed wins
